title: Dispatch understands you better
changes: Say just "Dispatch" and pause, like on a real radio: the dispatcher answers "Go ahead" and takes whatever you say next. Before, it ignored both
The dispatcher waits a moment longer before deciding you have finished talking, so a pause in the middle of a sentence no longer cuts it in half
In RPM CyberCom traffic stops, "the 10-11 is over", "10-11 done" and "code 4" now end the stop. "Dispatch, radio check" gets "loud and clear" from the helper bots too
If RPM cannot join a patrol channel because of its permissions or a full channel, it stops retrying and says why under Last heard in /config dispatch
